title: Assertion: No Starvation
constraints: Masters keep `req[i]` high until they are granted. Rule: once `req[i]` rises, `gnt[i]` must arrive within 0 … 4 cycles (a bounded-latency, starvation-free arbiter).
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: `$rose(req[i]) |-> ##[0:4] gnt[i]` for each master, using a generate loop.
The window starts in the cycle of the rising edge: an immediate grant is fine.

examples.title: served
examples.input: all four request, grants within 4 cycles

examples.title: same cycle
examples.input: gnt in the same cycle as req
